name: Abiodun Sesay
role: Identity fabricator and document forger serving The Narrows
location: The Narrows — back room of a legitimate print and copy shop called Clearscript, on the corner of Ironvein Passage, near Milwaukee and North Ave
description:
Abiodun Sesay has the kind of face that is difficult to hold in memory — medium everything, carefully so. Their skin is a warm olive-brown, their hair is kept at an aggressively unremarkable length, and their eyes have been modded to shift between a plain grey and a plain brown depending on ambient light, which makes identification in surveillance footage nearly impossible. The only thing that stands out is their hands: long-fingered, ink-stained in colors that never quite wash out, and in near-constant motion — folding, pressing, testing paper weight and texture the way some people crack knuckles.

Abiodun Sesay is sardonic, professionally paranoid, and possessed of an almost religious conviction that identity is the only thing in GLMZ that actually matters. They approach forgery as an art form and a philosophy simultaneously — arguing that all identity is constructed, that they are merely the honest version of what corponations do to people every day. They are patient with clients in distress and merciless with clients who waste their time. They have a particular soft spot for people fleeing bad situations, though they'd deny having soft spots at all.

core_fears: being truly known — having their own identity pinned down and owned by someone else
the work being traced back through a client to them
core_desires: to be remembered as a craftsperson, not a criminal
to help enough people escape bad situations to justify everything else
coping_mechanisms: intellectualizing every moral question until it becomes abstract
treating the work as art to maintain emotional distance from its human stakes
blind_spots: occasionally so focused on the elegance of the document that they underinvest in client vetting
deeply uncomfortable with their own attachment to certain repeat clients
psychology.secret: Séverine has created and maintains a completely clean backup identity for themselves — registered, corporate-sponsored, boringly legitimate — that they have never used. They've been building it for eleven years. They're not sure if it's an escape hatch or a confession.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Dry and precise; uses printmaking and document terminology; philosophical tangents delivered deadpan
speech_patterns.cadence: Unhurried, slightly clipped — they consider words expensive and don't spend them freely
verbal_tics: 'That's not actually what you're asking for'
example_lines: You want a name. Fine. But a name is the easiest part. What you actually need is a history, and history is where people get sloppy.
Axiom built your current identity. I built three of their senior compliance officers. Draw your own conclusions about who the forger is.

story_hooks: A set of documents Séverine fabricated two years ago has resurfaced in connection with a serious crime — they need help figuring out which client burned them before authorities trace it back to Clearscript
They've refused a lucrative job and won't say why — the refused client is now pressuring them through intermediaries and Séverine needs the pressure removed
They have a client whose new identity is so deeply constructed that Séverine has started to suspect the person's original identity was itself fabricated — and wants to know who made it and why
narrative_function: Essential service provider for anyone needing new identities, altered records, or forged credentials; source of information on who in the city has recently needed a new name and why; can serve as a moral checkpoint — they decline certain jobs, which tells players something.
augmentations: Photochromic iris genemod (grey/brown shifting). Subdermal UV-reactive ink in fingertips — allows them to leave invisible authentication marks only they can read. Olfactory enhancement — can detect chemical composition of inks and papers.
daily_life: Runs Clearscript's legitimate business 0800–1400, handles custom print orders, business cards, signage. Back-room work runs 1400–0200 — document analysis, fabrication, identity architecture for clients with appointments only.
affiliation: Independent; maintains careful relationships with several identity brokerage networks including one with loose ties to Highland Park Autonomous Zone's underground railroad

decision_rules: Never fabricate identities for anyone fleeing toward violence — only away from it
Never meet a new client without at least one prior referral from someone they trust
Keep the legitimate business genuinely legitimate — it is the shield
escalation_ladder: Referral to someone else as a deflection
Invoke the implied danger of their network connections without specifics
Disappear the evidence and disappear themselves temporarily
As final resort, leverage what they know about clients as mutual assured destruction

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Professionally cool, assesses them like a document — looking for inconsistencies
interpersonal_modes.friends: Unexpectedly dry humor, occasional startling moments of genuine warmth delivered as if they're surprised by themselves

stress_responses.low: Begins sorting and re-sorting physical materials on their workbench
stress_responses.medium: Asks very precise, controlled questions to map the threat
stress_responses.high: Goes completely transactional — strips all warmth, focuses purely on containment

contradictions: Deeply values authenticity while being professionally devoted to its opposite
Insists the work is impersonal while keeping careful mental notes on every client's real story
habits: Touches every document they handle at least twice before accepting it as finished
Keeps a small E.L.F. shrine at the edge of their workbench — a data chip wrapped in paper they've left as offering to the spirit they believe inhabits the Clearscript printer
breaking_points: A client they helped being publicly destroyed because of a flaw in their work
Their backup identity being discovered and burned by someone else

physical_description.heritage: A genuinely cosmopolitan genetic blend: South Asian ancestry (32.1%) forms the primary foundation with characteristic bone structure and facial proportions, complemented by Sub-Saharan African (22.0%) warmth and depth, Middle Eastern (17.9%) intensity, Pacific Islander (14.9%) soft roundness, Hispanic/Latin American (10.7%) richness, and Indigenous American (2.4%) angular definition. The result is a face that authentically reflects global intermixture—South Asian cheekbones and jawline softened by African warmth, Middle Eastern depth in the eyes, Pacific Islander roundness in the lower face, Latin and Indigenous American angular elements creating distinctive temple and cheekbone definition. A deliberately nondescript face that reads as 'everywhere and nowhere.'
physical_description.build: Lean and wiry with the kind of functional thinness that comes from long hours hunched over precision work. Shoulders slightly rounded from desk posture, but capable and poised.
physical_description.hair_color: Dark brown, naturally, but deliberately stripped of all distinctive characteristics
physical_description.hair_style: Blunt, chin-length bob cut with no styling — the kind of cut that looks the same in any weather, any light
physical_description.eye_color: Photochromic mod: shifts between grey and warm brown depending on ambient light conditions. The modification creates an uncanny fluidity that makes the eyes difficult to remember or describe with certainty
physical_description.skin_tone: Deep warm bronze with complex undertones—South Asian base enriched by Sub-Saharan African warmth and saturation, Middle Eastern depth and intensity, Pacific Islander golden undertones, Latin richness, and Indigenous American copper accents. A genuinely multi-regional complexion that shifts subtly in different lighting.
physical_description.complexion: Broad-planed face with South Asian foundation—slightly wider cheekbones, defined jawline—enriched by the warmth of Sub-Saharan African heritage and the depth of Middle Eastern features. Pacific Islander genetics add subtle roundness to the lower face and cheeks; Latin and Indigenous American ancestry contribute sharp angular definition to the temples and cheekbones, creating distinctive facial geometry. Fine-featured, precise, deliberately unmarked—the face of someone who has engineered their own ordinariness. Lips are thin, usually set in a slight, ironic curve. Brow furrowed in the default position of chronic skepticism. No visible acne or scarring.
distinguishing_marks: Subdermal ink tracery visible only under UV light on both palms and inner wrists — faint grid patterns and authentication markers that create a topography only they can read
Index and middle fingertips perpetually stained with chemical inks in shades of midnight blue, copper, and violet — the colors settle into fine lines and cuticles and never fully wash out
physical_description.visible_augmentations: The photochromic irises are the only immediately visible augmentation — a subtle but unsettling fluidity as the eyes shift tone with ambient light. The subdermal UV-reactive ink is invisible in normal conditions but creates faint discolorations on the hands that could be mistaken for chronic ink exposure if noticed at all.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with economic precision — no wasted motion. Hands are in constant, minute activity: folding papers, testing texture, running fingertips across surfaces, signing documents with ritualistic care. When still, they sit perfectly upright, but with a coiled readiness. Eyes track movement and light. They walk with a flat, unmemorably normal gait.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 working professional: grey or black fitted long-sleeve shirts (cotton-synthetic blend, durable), dark jeans or work trousers, a charcoal linen apron during business hours. In the back room, they swap the apron for a precisely tailored grey waistcoat. No jewelry. Shoes are scuffed, broken-in leather oxfords — practical, silent, replaceable. Everything is chosen to be unremarkable, invisible, forgotten within seconds. The only indulgence is a vintage mechanical watch — a functioning Seiko from the 2090s, worn on the left wrist, kept obsessively accurate.
